description: This file defines the LeaveRequest entity class for the OrangeHRM leave plugin system. It includes ORM mappings, method definitions for accessing and modifying leave request data, and uses Doctrine ORM and custom decorators to manage leave requests within the system.

classes.name: LeaveRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a leave request in the system, with ORM mappings to the database, fields for leave type, employee, date applied, and associated leaves, as well as getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave request.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type associated with this leave request.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Associates a leave type with this leave request.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns the date when the leave request was applied.

methods.name: setDateApplied
methods.description: Sets the date when the leave request was applied.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee who made the leave request.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an employee with this leave request.

methods.name: getLeaves
methods.description: Returns the list of leaves associated with this leave request.

methods.name: setLeaves
methods.description: Sets the list of leaves associated with this leave request.
